ck: (24)kasitinanacarya evan ceti uktaritya pratananunane vyavastapite cetyarta aparanartikapetena sitasatanavaranaya tarnisatasananasataketi ityatityatina sukan nanavyaktinistan kunatvatityatinanupasankraha atipatenatnatvan nanavyaktinistan catitvatityasya krahananiti tu nantan etavata prapantena tasyEva vyavastapitatvat pratanikatvena tasyEva kantata upatatunucitatvaca sustaniti uktavitaya travyatvasyatnani sitatvenoktasityanavakasat pete tarnisatasananasatakatvanivesena sitasatanasya canavakasatiti pava nanvetavata sukatipaksakanunane katan purvoktatosaparihara iti cetitan sukatinanapyayavatravyapavitvenatnanyankikare patakapavat tesan pratyaksatvena tatprayocakanahatvasunyananokunatvasanpavaca sukan nanopinananavyaktinistan kunatvatrupavatityanuniyate tataca na sita satanan na cEvanapasitanta tarkikarityEtatprayokat asrayatvanusantatrtvanyatarasanpantasya satyakatakatvatva tosapavat nanovrternanopinasritatvanupapatya nanopinanusantatrkenEva satyaparyavasanatutesyasiteriti asyartasya tvitvatinaniti krantenEva lapana prtakukti nanu cEtrasariranityatyanunane prakuktatosapariharat katanasya sustatvanata aha — cEtrasariraniti uktaritya sitasatanavaranaya vastuta iti petavisesanan tarnisatasananasataketyarta ayan pava tatvirutacestakatvan tatkriyacanakaprayatnanusantatrananusanhitaprayatnacanyakriyavatvan ato noktavyapicara katatO prayatnacanyakriyavirahat etatartaneva cestapatan na cEvan katatertrstantatvasanpava iti vacyan vyatirekena nEtrasarirasyEva trstantatvasanpavatiti yatu tatvirutacestavatvan tatkriyakaryapratipantakakriyavatvan sariratvena hetuvisesanana katatO vyapicara iti tana intrarcunayo kantavatahatO virutakaryakriyavatorvyapicarat na copayasanpratipanEkasvanikatvapave satiti visesanana tosa iti vacyan visesanavEyartyataprayocakatvaca vinatO pinO virutatarnatikaranatvatahanatuhinavatityasyoktatosavaranaya vivaksitartanaha — civesaviti nanu virutatarnatikaranatvasya parasparatarnavatavrtitarnavatvarupasya hetorasiti nayinate civesvaratarnayorekatikaranakatvatityasankavaranaya virotan vivrnoti — virotasceti sahanavastananiyana parasparatikaranavrtitvan vatyakatukapavasca na nasyanasakapavarupa sarvacnatvasarvacnatvatinan tatapavat kintu pavapavatvarupa iti cnapanaya nityatvanityatvatavivetyuktan ata sitante
